## Why This Is Asked

This question probes how to extend gateway behavior without redeploys, focusing on runtime plugin loading, ordering, and failure handling.

## Key Concepts

- Plugin/Registry pattern
- Composite/short-circuit validation
- Runtime configuration reload
- Security and isolation of plugins

## Code Example

```javascript
// Minimal interfaces
class Validator { validate(req) { } }
class Registry { getValidatorsForRoute(route) { return []; } }
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you version validators and roll back a faulty one?
- How do you test the registry-driven pipeline end-to-end?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests the ability to design runtime extensibility with minimal core changes, using a Registry and Factory-like pattern alongside a clean Backend abstraction.

## Key Concepts
- Registry pattern for dynamic extension
- Strategy-like renderers decoupled from backends
- Backend adapters for SVG and Canvas

## Code Example
```javascript
interface Backend { begin(): void; draw(path: string): void; fill(): void; }
interface Renderer { render(shape: Shape, backend: Backend): void; }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test adding a new renderer without rendering a full scene?
- How would you handle renderer lifecycle (initialization, disposal) in a long-running app?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design runtime-extensible systems using the Command pattern and a registry to enable plugins.

## Key Concepts
- Command pattern, Registry, Dynamic plugin loading, Fault isolation, Help generation

## Code Example
```javascript
// Implementation sketch
interface Command { name: string; description: string; run(args: string[]): Promise<void>; }
class CommandRegistry { private commands = new Map<string, Command>(); register(c: Command){ this.commands.set(c.name, c); } get(name: string){ return this.commands.get(name); } list(){ return [...this.commands.values()]; } }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you secure plugin loading and sandbox execution?
- How would you handle conflicting command names and versioning?
